body.p: No claim has been AMENDED. No new matter is added. Thus claims 1-19 are pending.

Claims 1 to 6 and 14-17, and 19 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as being unpatentable over CN102707724B (hereinafter "the 724 publication") and in view of W02020181962A1 (hereinafter "Chen"), Berning et al, Space Craft Relative Motion Planning Using Chained Chance Constrained Admissible Sets, 10-17-19 (hereinafter "Berning") and in view of Goo, Dengwei, et al., Online feedback motion planning for spacecraft obstacle avoidance using positively invariant sets, Advances in Space Research Volume 65, Issue 10, 15 May 2020, Pages 2424-2434

Claims 7 is rejected as being unpatentable over the 724 publication, Chen, Berning, Goo, and US 20080098711A1 (hereinafter "DiSalvo"). Claims 8, 9, 11-13, and 18 are rejected as being unpatentable over the 724 publication, Chen, Berning, Goo, and WO 2022068155A1 (hereinafter "Zou"). Claim 10 the 724 publication, Chen, Berning, Goo, Zou, and US 20230152458 (hereinafter "Nuss").

Regarding independent claim 1, Applicant submits that Chen in its entirety does not teach or suggest the feature "execute, during the normal operation of the spacecraft, a nominal control law subject to constraints on maintaining a state of the spacecraft within a union of a plurality of control invariant sets of values of the state of the spacecraft" as recited in claim 1.
Chen describes "The satellite current operating status determining module 304 is

configured to determine a current operating status of the satellite based on the to-be-detected satellite telemetry data by using the optimized variational auto-encoder, where the current operating status includes a normal operating state or an abnormal operating state." See Chen at para [0095].

Applicant submits that Chen is merely directed towards detecting an operating status of a satellite. Chen does not disclose anything regarding what to do after detecting the operating status of the satellite. As such, Chen's teachings fall short of the claimed features of this invention. Particularly, there is no suggestion in Chen that would have led a person having ordinary skill in the art to the claimed feature of executing a nominal control law during the
normal operation of the satellite, let alone the execution of the control law being subject to constraints of the claimed type.
As such, the alleged combination of the cited arts does not render the independent claim 1 obvious.
Independent claims 14 and 19 recite analogous subject matter and are also allowable at least for the same reasons presented above for claim 1.
Dependent claims 2-13 and 15-18 are also allowable at least due to their dependence on amended independent claim 1 or 14.
Reconsideration and withdrawal is respectfully requested.

Applicant respectfully submits that pending claims 1-19 are in condition for allowance, and respectfully requests an early and favorable action by the Examiner. If the Examiner believes that a telephone conversation with Applicant's agent would expedite prosecution of this application, the Examiner is cordially invited to call the undersigned attorney of record.
